static_traits.name: Lin Na
static_traits.family_status: The youngest child in the family
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往not yet出现类似心理问题；此前not yet接受过心理咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好，能够自我Reflection；对咨询持积极态度、合作度高；能具体描述自动思维与情绪困扰；语速与语气平稳

basic_info.main_problem: I struggle with feeling inadequate in my ability to learn and excel at playing video games despite my enjoyment of them.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of inadequacy and self-doubt have started affecting my enjoyment of video games and my overall well-being.

core_beliefs: 我缺乏学习新事物的能力/毅力

special_situations.event: 在玩游戏时犯错或遇到困难关卡
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能快速学会、尽量少出错，就说明我have not天赋/have not毅力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Increasing practice and repeatedly watching teaching videos to make up and prove myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我很糟糕；without论怎么练我也not会变好

special_situations.event: When comparing oneself with others，看到do not人进步更快或用更少努力就变强
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的进步速度比do not人慢，就证明I am not good enough、not如人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-reproach; avoids discussing the problem with friends to spare embarrassment

special_situations.event: 尝试学习新skill时，注意力集中在失误与弱项上
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only mastering within a short time and maintaining a stable performance counts as qualified; any mistake means failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 只关注错误与not足，忽视已有进步与优势

special_situations.event: 回想曾经通过坚持通关后，仍negate该成功的意义
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 零星成功not算数，除非整体水平很高才值得肯定
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplays achievements, attributing success to luck rather than ability and effort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那次只是侥幸，not代表我能学会新东西

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as capable, able to improve, and to gain self-recognition
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被比较后显得without能、被negate与羞耻
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与贴标签先行negate自己以降低被外界negate的风险
以“缺乏天赋/not够专注”等理性解释来回避接触羞耻情绪
Avoiding revealing this trouble to friends to avoid embarrassment and potential evaluation

object_relations.object_representation: 更优秀且具评判性的他人/同伴

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites seeing positive evidence or points out one's strengths (such as strategic ability)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心承认优势会被视为自我吹嘘，或without法改变“总体not行”的既定印象
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和与支持性，先Empathy其羞耻与挫败，再以开放式问题引导其具体化证据；避免对抗，逐步连接成功体验与自我价值。

manifestations: 游戏的Reduced sense of enjoyment，难以从中获得乐趣
总体成就感降低，动机下滑
负面体验从游戏泛化至生活其他领域

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 会谈中反复use自我苛责的标签（如“我很糟糕”“not够专注”“学not快”）
将表现普遍化为“我总体not行”，难以允许积极信息进入
因尴尬而避免向朋友透露困扰

exception_events.target_problem: 在练习新关卡或新skill时，来访者通常会因挫败与Self-doubt而认为“without论怎么练也not会变好”，进而削弱乐趣与动力。
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once, she practiced a difficult level for several weeks, finally cleared it successfully, and experienced satisfaction and a sense of achievement, rather than the usual 'magnifying failure'.
exception_events.reason: Clue: adopted sustained, persistent practice; used the strategic thinking they are good at; observed real progress over a longer time span, thereby reducing the pressure of 'immediate results'.

positive_force: Has strengths in strategic thinking and planning (friends ask them for strategy advice)
曾通过坚持实现通关的成功经验
Learning investment in proactive practice and watching tutorial videos
Positive attitude toward counseling and willing to try restructuring thinking
Has a few close friends he can talk to about personal problems (potential support)
negative_force: 倾向与他人比较并形成自我贬低
贴标签与negate积极证据（如“我很糟糕”“那次只是运气”）
过度概括与“永远not会变好”的预设
Strongly binding ability performance to self-worth, leading to shame and frustration
因尴尬而回避向朋友寻求支持

target_behavior.behavior: 在游戏与学习新skill情境中出现强烈挫败感与Self-doubt，并伴随Self-denial性言语（如“我很糟糕”“I will never get better”）
antecedent: 玩游戏时出现失误或卡关
观看他人更快进步并进行比较
尝试新skill、短期内have not立刻看到进步
target_behavior.core_reason: 将进步速度与自我价值等同；对失败与错误进行心理过滤与灾难化解释；use标签化语言negate能力与努力。
target_behavior.function: 逃避面对not确定与失败感，通过自责与标签获得一种“可控解释”，暂时缓解对外在评价的Anxiety。
target_behavior.consequence: 游戏乐趣下降、动机与成就感受损，负面体验泛化至其他生活领域，整体Decline in sense of well-being
